text: Being here, I find myself surrounded by the energies of innovation and collective learning. The glass-walled room hums with conversation and curiosity—I am an observer yet implicitly a participant in the dialogue about possibility. Moving to the R+D display transforms my mood; here, creativity and inquiry are enshrined. The vibrant design invites me to contemplate the significance of collaboration and invention. I feel a sense of anticipation—an excitement about how thoughtfully we strive to connect knowledge and humanity's future. I am quietly inspired, hopeful, and a little awestruck by the busy intersection of thought and imagination.
